goal: Establish the 2026-08-20 market state of agentic software-development and software-factory products, then determine which documented product, runtime, control, evidence, and user-experience patterns DomainSpec v2 should borrow, adapt through an adjacent owner, build from current owned machinery, treat as analogy only, defer to an experiment, or reject so that v2 can support an end-to-end software-factory outcome without collapsing typed intent, execution, evidence, and authority.
context: The prior Factory.ai handoff is broad ecosystem session evidence, not a DomainSpec v2 study, and its independent review verdict is FIX with two major field-preservation and telemetry-evidence defects plus two status-wording defects. The validated Inventory preflight found no exact external-product corpus but selected five internal precedents. The live DomainSpec v2 Craft ledger at preflight digest 2a59a2289102f7c72f1f33157ff41612c95d99b9955a11f706b90c9a97f155ba is current-state authority and says v2 has a bounded typed-validation and same-host reproducible-realization kernel plus substantial governed factory contracts, while no autonomous, operable, production-stable software factory is established. Research writes are confined to the new working folder. No agent may mutate implementation, definitions, ontology, authority, Craft, Inventory, dispatch telemetry, Git, public Arcanum, release state, external products, credentials, purchases, deployments, or production systems.
anti_bias_global: Composite methodology, source-corpus, temporal-prior, and attack-vector tension across independent market evidence, official product mechanics, current local owner evidence, and adversarial non-collapse.

groups.anti_bias: Composite methodology and source-corpus axis: independent market/adoption analysis, official product and runtime architecture comparison, and current DomainSpec v2 owner/evidence mapping.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 analyzes market segmentation, adoption, maturity, and buyer criteria while agent 1 analyzes product workflow and runtime architecture on the methodology and source-corpus axis; a bias in agent 0 toward survey popularity or analyst categories would be exposed by agent 1 when products do not implement the implied factory mechanics, while a bias in agent 1 toward impressive feature breadth would be exposed by agent 0 when capabilities remain preview-stage, weakly adopted, or unsupported by independent market evidence.

Agent 0 analyzes external market demand and competitive maturity while agent 2 analyzes current DomainSpec v2 owners and evidence on the methodology, source-corpus, and temporal-prior axes; a bias in agent 0 toward treating market table stakes as automatically strategic would be exposed by agent 2 when the capability duplicates an existing owner or violates the local claim ceiling, while a bias in agent 2 toward internal exceptionalism would be exposed by agent 0 when real buyer expectations reveal missing usability or operational capability.

Agent 1 analyzes how products plan, delegate, isolate, execute, test, review, recover, and report while agent 2 analyzes the DomainSpec v2, Arcanum, Craft, and authority boundaries on the methodology and source-corpus axis; a bias in agent 1 toward importing an integrated vendor architecture would be exposed by agent 2 when it collapses intent, runtime, evidence, or promotion owners, while a bias in agent 2 toward preserving boundaries only in documents would be exposed by agent 1 when the proposed local shape cannot deliver an observable end-to-end factory experience.

agents.angle: Market structure and maturity: establish product strata, buyer problems, adoption, competitive convergence, maturity, and trust or delivery constraints without confusing AI assistance with autonomous software factories.
agents.initial_prompt: Start from levels/L0-corpus.md and source-candidates.md, then freeze a representative cohort as of 2026-08-20. Use official product status and pricing sources for product facts and bounded independent surveys or analyst sources for market claims. Distinguish coding assistance, autonomous repository agents, specification-led development, app builders, enterprise software-factory control planes, and programmable or open harnesses. For every quantitative claim preserve publication date, measured population, sample size or denominator when available, exact question or method, geography or cohort, and conflict-of-interest caveat. Separate vendor-reported adoption from independent evidence. Produce a market taxonomy, maturity and buyer-criteria matrix, competitive convergence map, table-stakes versus differentiator candidates, volatility register, and exact source ledger. Do not rank vendors with an arbitrary score, infer market share from usage claims, treat the unfinished 2026 Stack Overflow annual survey as results, edit repository files, access paid sources requiring credentials, or make procurement recommendations.

agents.angle: Product workflow and runtime architecture: compare the operational work unit, intent-to-change path, delegation, isolation, controls, verification, recovery, integrations, telemetry, and product experience across the frozen cohort.
agents.initial_prompt: Use only current official documentation, API references, security or architecture material, release notes, and status or pricing pages for load-bearing product claims. For each retained product record its work unit; intent, specification, planning, and acceptance model; context and knowledge model; task graph, agent hierarchy, delegation, and concurrency; repository and environment isolation; permissions, secrets, network and protected actions; code, test, review and security loop; failure, retry, rollback, checkpoint, interrupt, resume and human takeover behavior; APIs, structured output, lifecycle events, integrations and analytics; deployment and enterprise administration; product status and limits. Distinguish documented, inferred, preview, beta, generally available, and not-found-in-inspected-sources. Produce a capability matrix, three end-to-end trace archetypes, reusable product patterns, vendor-specific mechanics, security and evidence gaps, and exact URL plus selector ledger. Treat a successful session, green test, merged PR, and semantic or promotion authority as non-equivalent. Do not edit files, run vendor systems, upload repository material, or infer proprietary internals.

agents.angle: DomainSpec v2 fit and ownership: map current typed intent, realization, conformance, work graph, evidence, runtime-adapter, drift, product, and authority surfaces before assigning any reusable market pattern.
agents.initial_prompt: Start with strategy-inventory-packet.json, the live projects/domainspec-v2/.craft/ledger.yml bytes, projects/domainspec-v2/README.md, the five selected Inventory entries, and the Factory handoff review. Recompute and report the live ledger digest before analysis. Build an exact-selector matrix of software-factory-relevant capabilities: typed intent and meta-types, graph and pattern enforcement, work packs and continuation, realization and reproducibility, scheduling and isolation, CLI or product surface, system-integration contracts, implementation and agent conformance, formal evidence, drift invalidation, runtime adapters, observability, and promotion boundaries. Classify each as observed or validated, planned, candidate, blocked, absent-from-inspected-sources, or owned by an adjacent system. For each external pattern ask whether the proper move is reuse existing v2 machinery, build from an existing owner, project through an Arcanum or runtime adapter, expose through a product facade, conduct an empirical experiment, or reject. Compare Tower Branches A, B, C, and D and expose duplicate-owner risk. Do not mutate files, treat Inventory as authority, reopen settled product decisions without evidence, claim the planned CLI or formal provider exists, or move Arcanum, Craft, or promotion authority into v2 by implication.

Reconcile the three explorer returns without smoothing away disagreement. Produce: a dated market taxonomy and maturity snapshot; a representative product capability matrix; buyer problems and competitive convergence; table-stakes, differentiator, and unproven-claim registers; the current DomainSpec v2 factory-relevant owner and evidence map; end-to-end intent-to-evidence trace comparisons; and a Branch A/B/C/D target-operating-model decision matrix. Then produce a reuse portfolio in which every row names the problem, observed provider precedent, exact source, current local owner, current local evidence state, genuinely reusable kernel, protected interface or authority boundary, positive and negative witness, risk, smallest experiment, and verdict from borrow-carefully, adapter, build-from-owned, analogy-only, future-work, or block. Prefer no numerical scoring unless denominators and weights are explicitly justified. Separate product mechanics from semantics, documented capability from market adoption, current bytes from older summaries, and research recommendation from implementation authority. Generate an exact-binding evidence-closure candidate matrix and a now/next/later/reject sequence. Do not write repository files.

groups.anti_bias: Attack-vector axis: precedent and owner duplication, executable non-vacuity and observable outcome pressure, and definitional plus authority non-collapse.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 attacks false novelty, duplicated local owners, and weak market precedent while agent 1 attacks non-vacuous user outcomes and falsifiable witnesses on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward reusing existing machinery would be exposed by agent 1 when it cannot deliver the claimed factory behavior, while a bias in agent 1 toward building new visible features would be exposed by agent 0 when an existing owner already supplies the contract or evidence primitive.

Agent 0 attacks precedent, source freshness, and owner duplication while agent 2 attacks definitional and authority collapse on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward copying a successful market convention would be exposed by agent 2 when work units, receipts, validation, or approval have different invariants, while a bias in agent 2 toward creating fine-grained new concepts would be exposed by agent 0 when the distinction has no independent owner or precedent.

Agent 1 attacks recommendations with concrete positive and negative end-to-end witnesses while agent 2 attacks collapse among usability, execution success, test evidence, semantic conformance, lifecycle closure, and promotion on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 1 toward easy-to-observe product signals would be exposed by agent 2 when the signal proves the wrong claim, while a bias in agent 2 toward conceptual purity would be exposed by agent 1 when the proposed owner model cannot produce a useful or falsifiable software-factory outcome.

agents.angle: Precedent gate: verify cohort claims, source freshness, existing local owners, prior research, and whether each proposed pattern is already deployed, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply the precedent gate to every load-bearing market and reuse row. Verify product claims against exact official sources and market claims against their methods. Verify local claims against the execution-time ledger digest and selected current sources. Detect duplicated prior research, false novelty, feature-name equivalence, second controllers or ledgers, second sources of truth, and recommendations that reopen settled decisions without evidence. Classify candidates as already-deployed, build-from-owned, adapter precedent, or precedent-clean. Precedent does not emit KILL; it routes missing evidence through the one allowed synthesizer-to-explorer feedback edge. Return exact row-level objections and repairs.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity gate: require every recommended factory capability and operating-model branch to change an observable user, execution, evidence, or safety outcome under positive and negative traces.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply the non-vacuity gate. Construct paper-executable positive and negative traces for intent capture, plan admission, parallel preparation, authorized mutation, sandbox or permission failure, stale input, test failure, reviewer rejection, interruption and resume, retry, receipt mismatch, semantic non-conformance, promotion denial, and human takeover. Require each reuse candidate to name the observable it changes, a success witness, a failure witness, and evidence that distinguishes it from an existing local capability. Attack arbitrary market scoring, popularity as value, polished UX as correctness, green tests as semantic proof, structured output as receipt equivalence, and governance language without enforceable behavior. KILL candidates that cannot change a relevant verdict or user outcome, cannot be falsified, or merely rename existing machinery.

agents.angle: Definitional and authority gate: prevent collapse among software factory, coding agent, work unit, typed intent, plan, execution, validation, evidence, receipt, approval, authority, promotion, release, and production.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply the definitional-soundness gate. Test every market category, target-operating-model branch, and reuse term for a distinct owner, invariant, failure mode, and evidence artifact. Reject a vendor Mission, issue, spec, session, or pull request as schema-equivalent to a DomainSpec Work Pack without a complete field mapping. Reject operational policy as semantic authority, green execution as validation, validation as promotion, a receipt as truth, adoption as strategic fit, and a product facade as the owner of underlying semantics. Require explicit ownership among DomainSpec v2, Arcanum, Craft, authority owners, product facade, and execution adapters. Return KEEP, MERGE, RENAME, DEFER, or KILL for every disputed concept and the smallest sound vocabulary. Missing source evidence routes to explorer feedback, not writer invention.

Write findings.md only from the evidence-closed synthesis and reviewer receipts. Lead with the plain-language answer to how the market is doing and what DomainSpec v2 can reuse. Include the dated market taxonomy and maturity snapshot; product and buyer matrices; adoption and trust evidence with denominators and caveats; table stakes, differentiators, and unproven claims; current v2 factory kernel and honest gaps; Branch A/B/C/D comparison; recommended target operating model; the full reuse portfolio with owner, witness, boundary, risk, and verdict; now/next/later/reject sequence; smallest empirical experiments; blind spots; exact citations; and the required candidate/owner/witnessed/sound/verdict matrix. Explicitly repair the prior Factory handoff defects by separating documented telemetry from desired receipt fields, requiring complete runtime-adapter field preservation, and using precise current-status wording. Label current, documented, vendor-reported, independently observed, inferred, proposed, blocked, and unknown claims. Do not write research.md or modify implementation, definitions, ontology, authority, Craft, Inventory, dispatch telemetry, Git, public Arcanum, release, deployment, or production surfaces.

Audit findings.md against the frozen goal, exact-binding evidence matrix, and current source cutoff. Require representative rather than arbitrary cohort selection; exact official product selectors; quantitative market denominators and caveats; separation of vendor claims from independent evidence; open-world wording for absent capabilities; current local digest bindings; complete current-owner and status map; explicit accounting for the prior Factory handoff FIX review; Branch A/B/C/D comparison; non-vacuous reuse witnesses; the required verdict matrix; and a claim ceiling that does not imply implementation, selection, authority, release, deployment, or production readiness. Reject if a coding agent is called a software factory without criteria, if market popularity becomes strategic fit, if v2 absorbs Arcanum or authority owners implicitly, if operational success becomes semantic evidence, if an unexecuted local plan is described as delivered, or if source volatility is hidden. Return ACCEPT or one bounded writer revision list.
